scope: Native in-process MCP without transport proxy; retained real gopls. Five ten-call cohorts after calibration, with setup, preparation, metrics retrieval and final oracles outside timed calls.

notification_policy.ordinary_open_go_changes: Full content didChange, increasing versions; no duplicate saves or type2 watcher events.
notification_policy.publication: Same-content unpublished-to-published transition sends didChange with increasing version.
notification_policy.fallback: didSave when changed/published content retains prior disk identity and mtime; preserves saved-overlay semantics, does not evict gopls disk cache.

historical_comparison.note: Earlier native cohorts on the same machine and corpus, not concurrent randomized control arms. Historical source hashes remain in the baseline artifact.

verification.independent_implementation_review: No blocking regression identified; final MCP verification checks clean diagnostic counts and no restart on reload.
